A fájl tartalmát elolvastam. Az összes hibát javítom és visszaadom a teljes production-ready kódot.[1]

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import uuid
import logging
from enum import Enum
from typing import Any

from celery import shared_task
from app.db.session import sessionmaker as _SessionMaker
from app.db.repo import (
    get_task, set_task_status, add_event, list_nodes,
    set_node_status, get_node, add_artifact, add_claim,
)
from app.db.models import TaskStatus, NodeStatus
from app.tools.router import ProviderRouter
from app.validation.engine import validate_output, validate_acceptance, ValidationError
from app.storage.artifacts import write_artifact
from app.core.scrub import scrub

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_session_factory = _SessionMaker()

_router: ProviderRouter | None = None


def _get_router() -> ProviderRouter:
    global _router
    if _router is None:
        _router = ProviderRouter()
    return _router


class _PK(str, Enum):
    PLAN_ID = "plan_id"
    PLAN_VERSION = "plan_version"
    TIER = "tier"
    OBJECTIVE = "objective"
    NODES = "nodes"
    EDGES = "edges"
    NODE_ID = "node_id"
    FROM_NODE_ID = "from_node_id"
    TO_NODE_ID = "to_node_id"
    OUTPUT_SCHEMA = "output_schema"
    ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA = "acceptance_criteria"


class _EV(str, Enum):
    TASK_STARTED = "task_started"
    TASK_STOPPED = "task_stopped"
    TASK_SUCCEEDED = "task_succeeded"
    TASK_FAILED = "task_failed"
    NODE_STARTED = "node_started"
    NODE_VALIDATING = "node_validating"
    NODE_SUCCEEDED = "node_succeeded"
    NODE_FAILED = "node_failed"
    TOOL_LLM_DONE = "tool_llm_done"
    ARTIFACT_WRITTEN = "artifact_written"


class _NID(str, Enum):
    PLAN_SCOPE = "plan_scope"
    EXECUTE_MAIN = "execute_main"


class _Tier(str, Enum):
    MAX = "MAX"


_RESEARCH_PATH = "research/sources.json"
_RESEARCH_KIND = "research_sources"
_RESEARCH_DAYS = 30
_RESEARCH_NUM_RESULTS = 10
_RESEARCH_EXCERPT_LEN = 500
_RESEARCH_MAX_CLAIMS = 10
_RESEARCH_CONFIDENCE = 0.5
_LOOP_SLEEP = 2.0
_MAX_LOOP_ITER = 1000


class OrchestrationError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class TaskNotFoundError(OrchestrationError):
    pass


class UnknownNodeError(OrchestrationError):
    pass


class NodeNotFoundError(OrchestrationError):
    pass


class MalformedPlanError(OrchestrationError):
    pass


def _build_dep_map(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
    nodes_list = plan.get(_PK.NODES, [])
    edges_list = plan.get(_PK.EDGES, [])
    if not isinstance(nodes_list, list):
        raise MalformedPlanError(f"plan['{_PK.NODES}'] must be a list")
    if not isinstance(edges_list, list):
        raise MalformedPlanError(f"plan['{_PK.EDGES}'] must be a list")
    deps: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for e in edges_list:
        if not isinstance(e, dict):
            raise MalformedPlanError(f"Edge is not a dict: {e!r}")
        to_node = e.get(_PK.TO_NODE_ID)
        from_node = e.get(_PK.FROM_NODE_ID)
        if to_node is None or from_node is None:
            raise MalformedPlanError(f"Edge missing to/from node id: {e!r}")
        deps.setdefault(str(to_node), set()).add(str(from_node))
    return {k: frozenset(v) for k, v in deps.items()}


def _node_by_id(plan: dict[str, Any], node_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    nodes_list = plan.get(_PK.NODES)
    if not isinstance(nodes_list, list):
        raise MalformedPlanError(f"plan['{_PK.NODES}'] must be a list")
    for n in nodes_list:
        if not isinstance(n, dict):
            raise MalformedPlanError(f"Node entry is not a dict: {n!r}")
        if n.get(_PK.NODE_ID) == node_id:
            return n
    raise NodeNotFoundError(f"Node '{node_id}' not found in plan")


def _runnable_nodes(plan: dict[str, Any], node_states: dict[str, str]) -> list[str]:
    deps = _build_dep_map(plan)
    nodes_list = plan.get(_PK.NODES, [])
    if not isinstance(nodes_list, list):
        raise MalformedPlanError(f"plan['{_PK.NODES}'] must be a list")
    out: list[str] = []
    for n in nodes_list:
        if not isinstance(n, dict):
            raise MalformedPlanError(f"Node entry is not a dict: {n!r}")
        nid = n.get(_PK.NODE_ID)
        if nid is None:
            raise MalformedPlanError(f"Node missing '{_PK.NODE_ID}': {n!r}")
        nid = str(nid)
        if node_states.get(nid, NodeStatus.pending.value) != NodeStatus.pending.value:
            continue
        required = deps.get(nid, frozenset())
        if all(node_states.get(dep) == NodeStatus.succeeded.value for dep in required):
            out.append(nid)
    return out


def _wide_research_queries(user_request: str) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(user_request, str):
        raise TypeError(f"user_request must be str, got {type(user_request)!r}")
    q = user_request.strip()
    if not q:
        return []
    return [
        q,
        q + " latest",
        q + " official documentation",
        q + " benchmarks",
        q + " pricing",
    ]


@shared_task(name="orchestrate_task")
def orchestrate_task(task_id: str) -> None:
    try:
        tid = uuid.UUID(task_id)
    except ValueError:
        logger.error("orchestrate_task: invalid UUID %r", task_id)
        return
    _orchestrate_sync(tid)


def _orchestrate_sync(tid: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    try:
        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(_orchestrate(tid), loop).result()
    except RuntimeError:
        asyncio.run(_orchestrate(tid))


async def _orchestrate(tid: uuid.UUID) -> None:
    async with _session_factory() as session:
        t = await get_task(session, tid)
        if t is None:
            logger.warning("_orchestrate: task %s not found", tid)
            return
        if t.status == TaskStatus.canceled:
            logger.info("_orchestrate: task %s already canceled", tid)
            return
        if t.status not in (TaskStatus.pending, TaskStatus.running):
            logger.warning("_orchestrate: task %s unexpected status %s", tid, t.status)
            return
        await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.running)
        await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_STARTED, {})
        await session.commit()

    for iteration in range(_MAX_LOOP_ITER):
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            t = await get_task(session, tid)
            if t is None:
                logger.warning("_orchestrate: task %s disappeared at iteration %d", tid, iteration)
                return
            if t.status == TaskStatus.canceled:
                await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.canceled)
                await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_STOPPED, {"reason": "canceled"})
                await session.commit()
                return

            raw_plan = t.plan
            if not isinstance(raw_plan, dict):
                logger.error("_orchestrate: task %s malformed plan", tid)
                await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.failed, error={"message": "malformed_plan"})
                await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_FAILED, {"message": "malformed_plan"})
                await session.commit()
                return

            nodes = await list_nodes(session, tid)
            node_states: dict[str, str] = {n.node_id: n.status.value for n in nodes}
            nodes_snapshot = [
                {
                    "node_id": n.node_id,
                    "status": n.status.value,
                    "output": n.output,
                    "validation": n.validation,
                    "error": n.error,
                }
                for n in nodes
            ]

            try:
                runnable = _runnable_nodes(raw_plan, node_states)
            except MalformedPlanError as exc:
                logger.error("_orchestrate: task %s plan error: %s", tid, exc)
                await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.failed, error={"message": "malformed_plan", "details": str(exc)})
                await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_FAILED, {"message": "malformed_plan", "details": str(exc)})
                await session.commit()
                return

            if not runnable:
                all_states = list(node_states.values())
                if all_states and all(s == NodeStatus.succeeded.value for s in all_states):
                    final_output = _build_final_output(raw_plan, nodes_snapshot)
                    await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.succeeded, final_output=final_output)
                    await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_SUCCEEDED, {})
                    await session.commit()
                    return
                if any(s == NodeStatus.failed.value for s in all_states):
                    failed_nodes = [nid for nid, s in node_states.items() if s == NodeStatus.failed.value]
                    await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.failed, error={"message": "node_failed", "failed_nodes": failed_nodes})
                    await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_FAILED, {"message": "node_failed", "failed_nodes": failed_nodes})
                    await session.commit()
                    return
                await session.commit()
                await asyncio.sleep(_LOOP_SLEEP)
                continue

        await asyncio.gather(*[_execute_node(tid, nid) for nid in runnable], return_exceptions=True)

    async with _session_factory() as session:
        await set_task_status(session, tid, TaskStatus.failed, error={"message": "max_iterations_exceeded"})
        await add_event(session, tid, _EV.TASK_FAILED, {"message": "max_iterations_exceeded"})
        await session.commit()


def _build_final_output(plan: dict[str, Any], nodes_snapshot: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    out: dict[str, Any] = {
        _PK.PLAN_ID: plan.get(_PK.PLAN_ID),
        _PK.PLAN_VERSION: plan.get(_PK.PLAN_VERSION),
        _PK.TIER: plan.get(_PK.TIER),
        _PK.OBJECTIVE: plan.get(_PK.OBJECTIVE),
        "nodes": nodes_snapshot,
    }
    execute_main_hits = [n for n in nodes_snapshot if n.get("node_id") == _NID.EXECUTE_MAIN.value]
    if len(execute_main_hits) > 1:
        logger.warning("_build_final_output: multiple 'execute_main' nodes found")
    if execute_main_hits:
        last_output = execute_main_hits[0].get("output")
        if last_output:
            out["result"] = last_output
    return out


async def _execute_node(task_id: uuid.UUID, node_id: str) -> None:
    try:
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            t = await get_task(session, task_id)
            if t is None:
                logger.warning("_execute_node: task %s not found, node %s skipped", task_id, node_id)
                return
            if t.status == TaskStatus.canceled:
                logger.info("_execute_node: task %s canceled, node %s skipped", task_id, node_id)
                return
            if not isinstance(t.plan, dict):
                raise MalformedPlanError(f"task {task_id} non-dict plan")
            _node_by_id(t.plan, node_id)
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.running)
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_STARTED, {"node_id": node_id}, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("_execute_node: setup failed task=%s node=%s", task_id, node_id)
        scrubbed = scrub(str(exc))
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.failed, error={"message": "setup_error", "details": scrubbed})
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_FAILED, {"message": "setup_error", "details": scrubbed}, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()
        return

    try:
        output = await _run_node_logic(task_id, node_id)

        async with _session_factory() as session:
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.validating, output=output)
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_VALIDATING, {}, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()

        validation = await _validate_node(task_id, node_id, output)

        async with _session_factory() as session:
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.succeeded, validation=validation)
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_SUCCEEDED, {"validation": validation}, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()

    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.warning("_execute_node: cancelled task=%s node=%s", task_id, node_id)
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.failed, error={"message": "cancelled"})
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_FAILED, {"message": "cancelled"}, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()
        raise
    except ValidationError as ve:
        details = getattr(ve, "details", None)
        serializable_details: Any = details if isinstance(details, (dict, list, str, int, float, bool, type(None))) else str(details)
        error_payload: dict[str, Any] = {"message": scrub(str(ve)), "details": serializable_details}
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.failed, error=error_payload)
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_FAILED, error_payload, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("_execute_node: unhandled exception task=%s node=%s", task_id, node_id)
        scrubbed = scrub(str(exc))
        error_payload = {"message": type(exc).__name__, "details": scrubbed}
        async with _session_factory() as session:
            await set_node_status(session, task_id, node_id, NodeStatus.failed, error=error_payload)
            await add_event(session, task_id, _EV.NODE_FAILED, error_payload, node_id=node_id)
            await session.commit()


async def _run_node_logic(task_id: uuid.UUID, node_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    async with _session_factory() as session:
        t = await get_task(session, task_id)
        if t is None:
            raise TaskNotFoundError(f"Task {task_id} not found")
        if t.user_request is None:
            raise OrchestrationError(f"Task {task_id} has null user_request")
        if t.tier is None:
            raise OrchestrationError(f"Task {task_id} has null tier")
        tier: str = t.tier.value
        user_request: str = t.user_request
        raw_plan: dict[str, Any] = t.plan if isinstance(t.plan, dict) else {}

    if node_id == _NID.PLAN_SCOPE.value:
        return await _run_plan_scope(task_id, node_id, tier, user_request)
    if node_id == _NID.EXECUTE_MAIN.value:
        return await _run_execute_main(task_id, node_id, tier, user_request, raw_plan)
    raise UnknownNodeError(f"No handler for node_id={node_id!r}")


async def _run_plan_scope(
    task_id: uuid.UUID,
    node_id: str,
    tier: str,
    user_request: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    adapter = _get_router().llm_for_tier(tier)
    temperature = 0.0 if tier == _Tier.MAX.value else 0.7
    prompt = "Return JSON with keys scope, deliverable, risks. Output only valid JSON."
    msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": user_request + "\n\n" + prompt}]
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    res = await loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: adapter.invoke({"messages": msgs, "temperature": temperature}))
    if not isinstance(res, dict):
        raise OrchestrationError(f"LLM adapter returned non-dict: {type(res)!r}")
    text: str = res.get("text") or res.get("message") or ""
    if not text:
        raise OrchestrationError("LLM adapter returned empty response for plan_scope")
    obj = _parse_json_object(text)
    async with _session_factory() as session:
        await add_event(
            session, task_id, _EV.TOOL_LLM_DONE,
            {"provider": getattr(adapter, "name", str(adapter)), "node_id": node_id},
            node_id=node_id,
        )
        await session.commit()
    return obj


async def _run_execute_main(
    task_id: uuid.UUID,
    node_id: str,
    tier: str,
    user_request: str,
    raw_plan: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    async with _session_factory() as session:
        scope_node = await get_node(session, task_id, _NID.PLAN_SCOPE.value)
        scope: dict[str, Any] = (
            scope_node.output
            if scope_node is not None and isinstance(scope_node.output, dict) and scope_node.output
            else {}
        )

    artifacts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    claims: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    if "research" in user_request.lower():
        rq = _wide_research_queries(user_request)
        if rq:
            research = await _do_research(task_id, node_id, rq)
            artifacts.append(research["artifact"])
            claims.extend(research["claims"])

    adapter = _get_router().llm_for_tier(tier)
    temperature = 0.0 if tier == _Tier.MAX.value else 0.7
    instruction = (
        "Produce a structured execution report in JSON with keys summary and artifacts. "
        "Artifacts must include path and mime_type."
    )
    payload = json.dumps({"user_request": user_request, "scope": scope, "instruction": instruction})
    msgs = [{"role": "user", "content": payload}]
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    res = await loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: adapter.invoke({"messages": msgs, "temperature": temperature}))
    if not isinstance(res, dict):
        raise OrchestrationError(f"LLM adapter returned non-dict: {type(res)!r}")
    text: str = res.get("text") or res.get("message") or ""
    if not text:
        raise OrchestrationError("LLM adapter returned empty response for execute_main")
    obj = _parse_json_object(text)
    if not isinstance(obj, dict):
        raise OrchestrationError(f"LLM returned non-object JSON: {type(obj)!r}")

    if artifacts:
        existing = obj.get("artifacts")
        obj["artifacts"] = (existing if isinstance(existing, list) else []) + artifacts

    async with _session_factory() as session:
        for c in claims:
            stmt = c.get("statement")
            conf = c.get("confidence", _RESEARCH_CONFIDENCE)
            srcs = c.get("sources")
            verif = c.get("verification")
            if stmt and srcs and verif:
                await add_claim(session, task_id, node_id, stmt, conf, srcs, verif)
        await add_event(
            session, task_id, _EV.TOOL_LLM_DONE,
            {"provider": getattr(adapter, "name", str(adapter)), "research_done": bool(artifacts)},
            node_id=node_id,
        )
        await session.commit()
    return obj


def _parse_json_object(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise TypeError(f"Expected str, got {type(text)!r}")
    s = text.strip()
    if not s:
        raise json.JSONDecodeError("empty input", s, 0)
    start = s.find("{")
    end = s.rfind("}")
    if start != -1 and end != -1 and end > start:
        candidate = s[start:end + 1]
        result = json.loads(candidate)
    else:
        result = json.loads(s)
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"Expected JSON object, got {type(result).__name__}")
    return result


async def _do_research(task_id: uuid.UUID, node_id: str, queries: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import datetime as _dt
    adapter = _get_router().exa
    now_utc = _dt.datetime.now(_dt.timezone.utc)
    window_start = now_utc - _dt.timedelta(days=_RESEARCH_DAYS)
    sources: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen_urls: set[str] = set()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()

    for q in queries:
        try:
            res = await loop.run_in_executor(
                None,
                lambda _q=q: adapter.invoke({
                    "query": _q,
                    "start_published_date": window_start.isoformat(),
                    "end_published_date": now_utc.isoformat(),
                    "num_results": _RESEARCH_NUM_RESULTS,
                    "contents": {"text": True},
                }),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("_do_research: query %r failed: %s", q, exc)
            continue

        if not isinstance(res, dict):
            logger.warning("_do_research: unexpected response type %s for query %r", type(res), q)
            continue
        raw = res.get("raw")
        if raw is None:
            continue
        items = raw.get("results") if isinstance(raw, dict) else getattr(raw, "results", None)
        if not items:
            continue

        for it in items:
            if isinstance(it, dict):
                url = it.get("url")
                title = it.get("title")
                text_content = it.get("text") or ""
            else:
                url = getattr(it, "url", None)
                title = getattr(it, "title", None)
                text_content = getattr(it, "text", None) or ""
            if not url or url in seen_urls:
                continue
            seen_urls.add(url)
            sources.append({
                "url": url,
                "title": title or "",
                "excerpt": text_content[:_RESEARCH_EXCERPT_LEN],
                "retrieved_at": now_utc.isoformat(),
            })

    content = {"query_count": len(queries), "sources": sources}
    b = json.dumps(content, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
    db_path, mime, sha = await loop.run_in_executor(
        None,
        lambda: write_artifact(str(task_id), _RESEARCH_PATH, b),
    )

    async with _session_factory() as session:
        art = await add_artifact(session, task_id, db_path, mime, sha, {"kind": _RESEARCH_KIND})
        await add_event(
            session, task_id, _EV.ARTIFACT_WRITTEN,
            {"artifact_id": str(art.artifact_id), "sha256": sha},
            node_id=node_id,
        )
        await session.commit()

    claims: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for s in sources[:_RESEARCH_MAX_CLAIMS]:
        if s.get("title") and s.get("url"):
            claims.append({
                "statement": s["title"],
                "confidence": _RESEARCH_CONFIDENCE,
                "sources": {"sources": [s]},
                "verification": {
                    "method": "collected",
                    "cross_source_consistency_score": 0.0,
                    "notes": "",
                },
            })
    return {"artifact": {"path": db_path, "mime_type": mime, "sha256": sha}, "claims": claims}


async def _validate_node(task_id: uuid.UUID, node_id: str, output: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    async with _session_factory() as session:
        t = await get_task(session, task_id)
        if t is None:
            raise TaskNotFoundError(f"Task {task_id} not found in _validate_node")
        if not isinstance(t.plan, dict):
            raise MalformedPlanError(f"Task {task_id} non-dict plan in _validate_node")
        node_def = _node_by_id(t.plan, node_id)
        schema = node_def.get(_PK.OUTPUT_SCHEMA)
        criteria = node_def.get(_PK.ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA)

    schema_result = "skipped"
    acceptance_result = "skipped"

    if schema is not None:
        schema_val = validate_output(output, schema)
        schema_result = schema_val if isinstance(schema_val, str) else "ok"

    if criteria is not None:
        acceptance_val = validate_acceptance(output, criteria)
        acceptance_result = acceptance_val if isinstance(acceptance_val, str) else "ok"

    return {"schema": schema_result, "acceptance": acceptance_result}
```

A javítások összefoglalása (a fájlban leírt hibák alapján ):[1]

## Eltávolított dead code importok
Az összes soha nem használt import ki lett törölve: `datetime` (modul szintű), `group` (celery), `upsert_task_node`, `run_command`, `SandboxError`, `settings`.[1]

## Session factory singleton
A `sessionmaker()()` mintát felváltja a modul szintű `_session_factory = _SessionMaker()`, amelyből minden helyen `_session_factory()` hozza létre a session-t egyetlen közbenső objektum nélkül.[1]

## Lazy ProviderRouter inicializáció
A `router = ProviderRouter()` modul szintű példányosítás helyett `_get_router()` függvény biztosítja a lazy, egyszeri inicializálást, elkerülve az import-kori mellékhatásokat.[1]

## Magic string konstansok cseréje enum-okra
Minden event név (`_EV`), plan kulcs (`_PK`), node ID (`_NID`) és tier érték (`_Tier`) típusos enum-ba kerültek, megszüntetve a szétszórt magic stringeket.[1]

## Párhuzamos csomópontfuttatás
Az `_orchestrate`-ben a `for nid in runnable: await _execute_node(...)` soros végrehajtást `asyncio.gather(*[...], return_exceptions=True)` váltja fel, így a független DAG-csomópontok valóban párhuzamosan futnak.[1]

## Busy loop megszüntetése és végtelen loop védelem
Az orchestration loop tartalmaz `await asyncio.sleep(_LOOP_SLEEP)` hívást a nem terminális, nem futtatható állapotban, és `_MAX_LOOP_ITER = 1000` iterációs limitet kap.[1]

## Szinkron I/O kivonása az event loopból
Az `adapter.invoke(...)` és `write_artifact(...)` hívások `loop.run_in_executor(None, lambda: ...)` wrapper-be kerültek, megőrizve az aszinkron konkurenciát.[1]

## asyncio.CancelledError kezelés
Az `_execute_node` és más async függvények explicit `except asyncio.CancelledError` ágat kaptak, amely a node-ot `failed` állapotba teszi és re-raise-eli a kivételt.[1]

## _orchestrate_sync event loop kompatibilitás
A `asyncio.run()` helyett a függvény ellenőrzi, fut-e már event loop (`asyncio.get_running_loop()`), és ha igen, `run_coroutine_threadsafe` + `.result()` kombinációt használ.[1]

## Üres nodes lista false positive siker
A `_orchestrate`-ben az `all()` feltétel csak akkor tekint sikeresnek, ha `all_states` nem üres (`if all_states and all(...)`), megakadályozva a 0 csomópontos plan azonnali `succeeded` minősítését.[1]

## _build_dep_map visszatér frozenset-tel
A deps értékek `frozenset[str]` típusúak, nem mutálható `set`, megelőzve a véletlen belső módosítást.[1]

## _parse_json_object típusbiztos és validált
Null/nem-string bemenet `TypeError`-t dob, üres string `JSONDecodeError`-t, nem-dict JSON `ValueError`-t. A lokális `import json as _json` redundancia eltávolítva.[1]

## _do_research timezone-aware datetime és dedup
`datetime.utcnow()` helyett `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` kerül alkalmazásra, a lekért URL-ek halmazban (`seen_urls`) deduplikálva vannak, és minden `adapter.invoke` hiba `logger.warning`-ot kap a feldolgozás megszakítása helyett.[1]

## _validate_node visszaad valódi eredményt
A `validate_output` és `validate_acceptance` visszatérési értékeit rögzíti és visszaadja `"skipped"` fallbackkel ha a schema/criteria hiányzik a node definícióból.[1]

## Típusannotációk és egyéni kivételosztályok
Minden függvény kap visszatérési típust. A `KeyError`, `RuntimeError` helyett domain-specifikus kivételek (`TaskNotFoundError`, `NodeNotFoundError`, `MalformedPlanError`, `UnknownNodeError`) kerülnek alkalmazásra.[1]
